releaseNotes.zh-CN: 悬停和展开默认日期/时间改为设置里可见的文本模板，可编辑或清空。清空并保存后不再恢复隐藏的日期、大时钟、常驻文本或操作提示；两个状态分别使用自己的模板，原生窗口与预览一致。旧空模板的一次性迁移保留原时钟/文本内容，已有非空模板及外观位置不改。真实任务列表、状态和进度保留。
releaseNotes.en-US: Expose hover and expanded date/time defaults as editable text templates. Saving a blank template no longer restores hidden dates, large clocks, compact text or action hints; each state uses its own template in both the native window and preview. One-time migration makes old implicit clock/text content visible while preserving existing nonempty templates and appearance. Keep real task lists, states and progress.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 移除 Codex 数据显示位置预设及胶囊内置额度行，外部数据仅通过常驻、悬停、展开自定义文本占位符显示。不引用占位符时不会自动显示额度或撑高胶囊；自动采集、数据显示开关、真实任务列表和计时功能保留。旧配置迁移保留三个文本模板、颜色、尺寸及位置，退休的位置设置被忽略。
releaseNotes.en-US: Remove Codex position presets and built-in quota rows. External data appears only through compact, hover and expanded text placeholders; without references it does not add quota content or enlarge the capsule. Keep automatic acquisition, the display switch, real task lists and timers. Migrate existing profiles without changing text templates, colors or geometry; ignore retired position settings.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 新增常驻、悬停、展开三个独立文本页签，悬停与展开支持同一套时间、计时器、倒计时及 Codex 数据占位符和无数据替代文本。展开支持换行及 Ctrl+Enter 保存，切换页签联动预览，刷新不覆盖未保存草稿。留空恢复默认内容；真实任务列表保留，展开自定义文本有独立区域。兼容旧配置，Codex 数据采集边界不变。
releaseNotes.en-US: Add independent compact, hover and expanded text editors using the same clock, stopwatch, countdown and Codex placeholders with missing-data fallbacks. Expanded text supports line breaks and Ctrl+Enter to save. Tabs select the matching preview; polling preserves unsaved drafts. Blank templates restore defaults, and real task rows remain intact with a separate expanded text slot. Existing profiles remain compatible; Codex observation boundaries are unchanged.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 新增计时器与倒计时，支持开始、暂停、继续、重置及文本占位符；关闭设置页后继续运行，停用模块时暂停。新增鼠标穿透和隐藏 30 秒/恢复，解决悬浮层遮挡操作。Codex 优先连接官方共享控制端点，失败则仅采集额度，并明确区分工作/等待状态与未接入桌面任务；不会启动或修改外部服务。本机或其他实例未开放共享端点时，仍不能读取其桌面对话。
releaseNotes.en-US: Add stopwatch and countdown timers with start/pause/resume/reset and text placeholders; keep timing after closing the settings page and pause on module deactivation. Add click-through and a 30-second hide/restore action. Prefer the official Codex shared control endpoint, fall back to account-only quotas, and distinguish observed working/waiting threads from unconnected desktop tasks. Never start or modify external services; instances without an exposed shared endpoint remain unobservable.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: Codex 外部程序运行时自动接入，退出后停止采集并清空旧数据；排除灵动岛自身及其他实例的辅助进程树。数据显示独立于采集，支持日期/时间区域、展开面板底部、仅自定义文本三种位置。新增时间、日期、Codex 主/次额度及读取时间占位符，支持全局或单独无数据替代文本；兼容旧配置。额度仍为账号百分比，不是精确 token 或其他窗口任务监控。
releaseNotes.en-US: Automatically acquire Codex data while an external Codex process is running; stop and clear stale data on exit, excluding helper process trees from all Island instances. Display is independent of acquisition, with clock-header, expanded-footer and template-only positions. Add time/date, primary/secondary quota, reset and refresh-time placeholders with global or per-token fallbacks. Migrate legacy settings. Quotas remain account percentages, not exact tokens or other-window task monitoring.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 灵动岛首个官方预览版：本地时钟、自定义文本、RGB 颜色、实色/半透明/自绘磨砂，支持停靠、位置与尺寸调节。设置复用工具箱主题与控件，修复刷新打断拖动的问题。可选 Codex 账号剩余额度百分比与重置时间常显于日期/时间区域；不是其他 Codex 窗口的任务监听器，也不提供精确剩余 token 数。
releaseNotes.en-US: First official Qing Island preview: a local clock, custom text, RGB colors, solid/translucent/self-rendered frosted materials, docking and adjustable geometry. Host-themed controls and refresh gating prevent interrupted edits. Optional real Codex account quota percentages and reset countdowns appear in the clock header; this is not a monitor of other Codex windows or an exact remaining-token counter.
